title: Dragonfly Messenger
description: A young woman with blue-streaked hair sits pensively by a glowing stream as a large, luminous dragonfly hovers between her and a dark armored knight standing on the opposite bank. The fantasy landscape features orange koi fish in the reflective water, glowing crystals, lotus flowers, a crescent moon, and a starry purple sky at twilight.
prompt: A young woman with long dark hair featuring bright blue streaks sits by a magical stream at twilight, resting her chin on her hand with a thoughtful expression. A giant glowing dragonfly flies in the center carrying sparkling particles toward a tall knight in dark ornate armor standing on the opposite grassy bank. Orange koi fish swim in the reflective water, white lotus flowers and glowing crystals are visible, with a purple starry sky, crescent moon, and distant trees in the background.
